plugins.description: Your operating partner from the Let's Chat Coach engine — a thinking partner for your work and working relationships (your deals, plans, docs, and managing yourself, your team, your boss, and your stakeholders) that remembers you across sessions. Adds a /coach skill plus the "Manage My…" shortcuts (/manageme, /manageteam, /manageboss, /managestakeholders, /managework) and connects the Let's Chat Coach server.
